The original failed-run executable was rebuilt before its bytes were copied; its recorded identity alone is retained, as the failed-run audit explicitly records. The image and GNU executable/image are unchanged. This observation does not replace the failed frozen run, explain the original timeouts, or establish authoritative performance.
